'''Stone Falls From the Mountain''' is a [[sword form]]. Aside from the name, nothing is known about it. [[Be'lal]] used this form against [[Rand al'Thor]] in the [[Stone of Tear]] during their duel over ''[[Callandor]]''.{{ref/book|3|55}}

==See also==
* [[Stones Falling Down the Mountain]], a sword form with a similar name.
